statement: ∀ (l : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ), let g := fun (σ : ℝ) => (l t)^2 * (1+σ*Real.cos (4*Real.pi*t)); 0 ≤ g 1 ∧ 0 ≤ g (-1) ∧ g 1 - g (-1) = 2*(l t)^2*Real.cos (4*Real.pi*t)
